critic.fix_suggestion: Apply a translation and rotation transform to the engine geometries to align them with the wing pylon coordinates. Specifically, move each engine along its local X-axis until it intersects the wing's lower surface at a 15-degree downward pitch, ensuring the engine's mounting face is flush against the pylon geometry to eliminate floating gaps.

discrepancies.observed: Engines are floating away from the wing and fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: Engines are physically attached to pylons on the wings.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Move engines toward and attach to wing pylon positions.

discrepancies.observed: The nose gear is detached and floating in front of the fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: Nose gear is connected to the underside of the forward fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Move nose gear forward/down to intersect with fuselage bottom.

discrepancies.observed: The vertical stabilizer is a flat plane disconnected from the rear fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: Vertical stabilizer is integrated into the rear fuselage structure.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Move and rotate tail to merge with rear fuselage geometry.

discrepancies.observed: Wings appear as separate floating shapes without proper root connection.
discrepancies.reference: Wings are seamlessly joined to the lower fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Move wing roots to intersect with the bottom of the main fuselage cylinder.
